scope: Four 100-update arms share rollout-denominator PPO clipping: baseline, Max only, Pro mask only, Max + Pro mask. One model and seed. Previous ICEPOP run is archived separately.
baseline_definition: Token-level PPO clip with current training / rollout inference ratio; clip interval [0.8, 1.28]; RLOO with shared global normalization; no extra IS multiplier or gate.
pro_definition: Frozen old/rollout causal prefix mask [0.5,5] applied to the same rollout-denominator PPO objective; no additional IS multiplier.
